verdict.rationale: The docs show fleet management for readers. Readers can be registered by registration code, serial number, or order number, and multiple readers across sites can be grouped into locations and zones through an API-flavored doc page. Configuring and monitoring readers is only documented as a Dashboard capability, not an API one. Missing for 10: explicit API evidence for monitoring reader status (online/offline, health), API-driven remote configuration updates, explicit confirmation that registration is exposed via API, and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic fleet management.
